answers.reason: Accepted; 'only' is too exclusive for 初めて and hardens the doctrine. 'for the first time' keeps the vague deictic unfixed.
Accepted; 'were' closes the vision into the past, and 'forever' detached from rest weakens 永久に夜の様な安息. Present 'are' with 'eternal' keeps it still going on.

data.revised_english: All the things of the world, a life, will pass. And on {t:that-day} when it has passed, everything, all things, will for the first time change into nostalgia and forgiveness. And at {t:that-day} they are before an eternal {t:rest} like night.
data.say: Accepted both queries to keep the doctrine unfixed and the vision ongoing.
